name: crust-language
description: Crust source highlighting through language services written in Crust.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The bundled seed highlighter reads source as data. Custom executables require workspace trust.

semanticTokenTypes.description: Region without a selected highlighting service

crust.highlighter.path.description: Highlight executable. Empty selects the bundled seed service. Relative paths use the workspace folder. Requires workspace trust.

crust.highlighter.arguments.description: Arguments before --tokens and the snapshot path for a custom executable. No shell expansion.

crust.highlighter.timeoutMs.description: Time limit for one highlight process, in milliseconds.
